releases.name: Restaurant Design and Setup Survey 2026-10-10
releases.body: Replaced the broken cloud connection with a simpler built in sync. The concept name, website, phone, address, point of sale, and ordering fields now link to the shared site profile.

releases.body: Connected the app to the shared restaurant data service. Added a new color palette.

releases.body: Created the app as version 1.0. It starts as a survey for designing a restaurant concept.

jobs.description: Survey tool for designing and scoring a restaurant concept, with sample concepts and a summary export.

releases.name: RESTACK 2026-10-10
releases.body: Fixed editing of custom items, import, and reset. Sites can now be renamed and deleted, and no default site is created automatically. Added a site profile window for the shared fields.

releases.name: RESTACK 2026-04-09
releases.body: Created the app and moved it to version 3, connected to the shared restaurant data service. Fixed the output folder so the site deploys correctly.

jobs.description: Technology stack explorer for restaurant sites that tracks what is known, partial, or missing.

releases.name: Tinewood Keys 2026-10-11
releases.body: Created the app. Version 1 is an electric piano with a light theme, octave buttons, sustain, and draggable knobs.

jobs.description: Browser electric piano with a light theme, octave shifts, sustain, and draggable knobs.

releases.name: ebutuoy 2026-10-11
releases.body: Moved the app to GitHub after a bug hunt pass. Triggered a production build.

jobs.description: Discovery app that plays short samples of rarely seen videos from small channels.

releases.name: ebutuoy backend 2026-10-11
releases.body: Ran a bug hunt. Search now returns only videos that can play in the embed, and subscriber checks fail closed. Added paging and quota tracking. Data now lives on the volume when one exists, and the service exits cleanly and logs fatal errors.

releases.name: ebutuoy backend 2026-05-27
releases.body: Added a clips table and clip endpoints.

releases.name: ebutuoy backend 2026-05-19
releases.body: Added a tag system and a replay queue for videos that become eligible after a day. Added a language filter and a playlist endpoint.

releases.name: ebutuoy backend 2026-05-18
releases.body: Created the backend with a seen videos record and a search that favors less popular videos. Added a roulette mode that picks places weighted by population.

jobs.description: Backend service for ebutuoy that finds little seen videos and remembers what was served.

releases.name: Cockpit Racer 2026-10-11
releases.body: Created the app as version 2. It is a low poly desert driving game with a wheel, gas, brake, traffic, and police.

jobs.description: Low poly 3D desert driving game from the cockpit, with traffic, deer, and a police cruiser.

releases.name: PIXELMILL 2026-10-11

jobs.description: Toolpath simulator that cuts endless pixel programs like spiral, hatch, pocket, and cityscape.

releases.name: Coffee Autosim 2026-10-11

jobs.description: Live blueprint simulator of a coffee shop floor where baristas fill tickets on their own.

jobs.description: Bird territory game with free paint, stained glass, and photo glass art modes.
